assumptions: Prefix-only native admission: zero CALLVALUE, calldata length at least four and below 2^64, actual loaded selector equals the compiler-bound function selector. Every lower selector-word bit and calldata tail remains arbitrary.
Prefix execution uses reviewed exact EVM instruction semantics, fresh zero memory, fitting stack/memory and sufficient reached execution resources.

Raw decoder, enum/alignment/window admission, empty and nonempty behavior, target checking, template copy, domain element extraction, accumulator and element stamping, callback receipts and gas-exhaustion guards, early exits, errors and exact physical terminal bytes remain required before public bytecode coverage.

Current runtime/source/compiler extraction and Dafny/Boogie/Z3 are trusted boundaries; source proofs do not substitute for exact compiled instruction verification. No gas, deployment or performance claims.
